reason: rank01 of clip(b-a,0,1) assigns mid-ranks to the ~50% zero support, penalising A-dominant pixels that should not be vetoed; the veto must rank only the suspected (positive) support

field_veto.formula: art=clip(b-a,0,1); veto=0 where art==0; veto=rank01(art) on art>0 only; field=(0.45*consensus+0.55*buried)*(1-0.70*veto)
